purpose: Measure complete-path posterior numerical adequacy and work/memory growth before longer aging trajectories or compression comparisons
solver: experiments/joint_health_posterior_001; unchanged arithmetic/configuration and finite adequacy thresholds

input_fixture.observation_representation: float64 fabricated voltage/current; no ADC12 hardware claim
input_fixture.rate_scope: Inherited artificial conditioning profile; no physical aging calibration
input_fixture.generation: Separate scalar physical equations and bounded normal rejection; health then propagation, same selected model; one128-record source, exact nested prefix files
input_fixture.truth_boundary: Generator owns plant initial state and latent path. Solver workers read only one observation-prefix file and inference.json, never this plant configuration or latent path. No truth scoring in this scaling study.

inference.query: Conditioned current marginal only; separate final-voltage prediction not rerun at each length
inference.initialization: Exact original bounded prior draws; no warm posterior, plant values or fitted centers
inference.thresholds: Unchanged smc.assess on all20 reported coordinates/functions, with original posterior.SCALES
inference.mode_diagnostics: Initial low-capacity component responsibility mean and replicate MCSE; no requirement to force both modes if data disfavor one

cost_probes.purpose: Prior/density arithmetic timing and path-array dimensions only; not posterior adequacy or full-runtime prediction

resource_accounting: Shared ledger reserves len(batch)*prefix before EVERY target.evaluate, including prior-draw validation calls. Denied batches do not enter inherited evaluator or change used-work counters. Per-prefix caps sum to a finite campaign upper bound; CPU/RSS/wall/output supervisor additionally limits all children. Completed populations persisted before later reports/gates.
progression: All three cost probes run first. Posterior lengths advance only after eight populations complete and unchanged numerical adequacy passes. On inadequacy or resource limit preserve partial/full artifacts, mark all later posterior lengths not_launched_by_gate, and finish reporting. No automatic extra particles, retries, tolerance changes or solver repair in this study.
qualification: Targeted fabricated guard boundary/atomicity, shared accounting across populations, inherited-arithmetic parity, record order and deterministic fixture-prefix checks before experiment
interpretation_limits: At nominal35Hz even128records is only about3.66seconds, not physical long-term aging
Finite Monte Carlo checks are not convergence proofs or coverage validation
No M23 runtime/memory qualification; deployment still SRAM-only within complete10240B
